column1: # min_vram_mib is the FLOOR the launcher gates on: the least free VRAM this profile has been seen to start and serve
# the full context at. Strata sizes its hot-expert cache to what is free (--expert-cache auto), so it runs with a
# smaller cache rather than failing, and the peak below is never a precondition (A-045).
# MEASURED on the RTX 4090 machine (i9-13900F, 62 GB RAM, RTX 4090 24564 MiB), Strata 0.1.39, IQ3_XXS, 2026-10-05,
# with a graphical session holding 523 MiB:
#   23,525 MiB free: started, 14.73 GiB expert cache, 23,535 MiB used in all; decode 111.9-143.6 tok/s.
#   the same build with --vram-reserve-mib 8000 (a 15,525 MiB budget): started, 7.87 GiB expert cache, 16,505 MiB
#   used in all; decode 68.5 tok/s. Both answered a 108,490-token prompt and reused 98,304 of it (90.6%) on re-ask.
# The floor is rounded up from the smaller of those two, and nothing below it has been tried.
# need_vram_mib is the peak, MEASURED 2026-10-02 on Strata 0.1.36: 23,805 MiB at start and 23,955 MiB after a
# 128k-token conversation (horizon/strata.md). It does not gate. need_ram_mib is the engine's resident set, and does.
